utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean like they're going to fix stuff for free? That sounds too good to be true.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nah, it's legit! The community center's organizing it—volunteers will fix small appliances and clothes for free.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, are you still planning to help with the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday? I think so, but remind me again what we're doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We're fixing up old bikes and donating them to the kids at the community center. Meet at my garage at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven't caught up on that yet. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just finished checking the tools. We're ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? Is that something we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to gather tools and spare parts for fixing things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So we bring our own tools and parts? Or is there a central collection?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, have you thought about how we can organize the repair drive with the school schedules?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh yes, I was thinking we could talk to the school office about having a sign-up sheet for times that work for parents and teachers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great idea! I can check with the PTA about coordinating the times with the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Oren, what's this about a repair drive? I like to know the schedule ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Hmm, I think I heard something about that. Maybe it's this weekend? I'll check my notes and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: This weekend? I need a definite date, not 'maybe'. Can you get back to me soon?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! Excited for the repair drive this Saturday? I'm telling everyone to come help out!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? I hope we have enough supplies and volunteers. Have we sorted out the tools and materials yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't you worry, I've been rounding up folks to bring their own tools and spare parts. It'll be a proper community effort!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rosa, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Do you know any details about it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. We'll have volunteers to fix small appliances, electronics, and clothes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! Do I need to bring my items or are there tools and supplies provided?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What kind of repair drive are we talking about? Is it for the old server or something else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's for folks to bring in broken electronics — I’m helping organize it. We’re starting with small appliances and maybe the old server if needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I see. So it's a community event for fixing items, not just for a specific server. Are you collecting donations or just offering repair services?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Dane. What's this about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Uli. Sorry I'm late—what exactly is the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community thing—folks are pitching in to fix up some broken fences and such. Just thought you might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need some tools for the repair drive? I've got a van full of them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of tools do you have?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, and a few power tools. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Bo, what's the status on that repair drive? I noticed some folks gathering near the old shed earlier.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that? Yeah, there's something going on. I think they're sorting out the tools or something.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know exactly which tools they're sorting? I could lend a hand if needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, heard you're organizing a repair drive—need me to lend some tools?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that'd be great. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, I've got a full set of wrenches and a power drill if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Kira, are you sure the repair drive is going to be enough for all the issues?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What makes you think that tiny thing can handle everything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't know, it just seems like it might not have the capacity for major problems.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think it's a great chance for us to help out around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I heard about it! I'd love to help out. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just bring yourself and any basic tools you have—we'll have plenty of supplies there!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I've been organizing the supplies for the repair drive. Do we have an update on what we need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, sorry I'm late. I haven't checked the supply list yet; what have you got so far?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a basic list started: nails, wood, and paint. But we're short on tarps and rope. Any idea where we can get those?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, did you hear about the community repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds great! I'll have to check if it conflicts with any of the kids' weekend activities.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's at the community center from 10 to 4, so hopefully it fits into your schedule!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, can you give me the short version? I'm in a rush.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing! We're collecting small repair items this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 2. Bring anything fixable, and we'll have volunteers on hand. Thanks for your time!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday 10-2 at the center. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, how's the repair drive going? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: All good, thanks. Could use a hand with the broken fence later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, just let me know when and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all pitching in to fix up the community center!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn't heard about that! What needs fixing at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Plenty! The roof's got a leak, some windows need reglazing, and the fence is falling apart. We could really use your help—will you join us?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Have you checked the repair drive location yet? I want to make sure we have the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I checked the map. It's at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, the community center parking lot is easy to find. I'll head over there now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need a bit more detail on what you mean by repair drive—could you clarify which device or system you're referring to?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh, I meant the community repair event this Saturday—are you planning to bring something?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... Did we start already?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think it started yesterday. Heard some folks were fixing the community fence.
